items.title: U.S., China reach trade 'gentleman’s agreement' but AI tensions mount: CSIS - CNBC
items.summary: Monday - Friday, 10:00 - 11:00 SIN/HK | 0400 - 05:00 CET. # U.S., China reach trade 'gentleman’s agreement' but AI tensions mount: CSIS. Scott Kennedy of CSIS said a "gentleman’s agreement" was reached by the U.S. and China to stabilize trade tensions. However, he noted AI is emerging as a point of friction, and separating commercial interests from national security will be "quite a challenge" as the U.S. flags "AI distillation" concerns. These high-stakes tech and security issues are expected to be on the agenda for the September Trump-Xi summit.
